description: This Java source file defines the class SudoRetrieveThing, which represents a command to retrieve a 'Thing' without authorization in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class includes methods for creating command instances, parsing from JSON, and serializing commands, encapsulating details like the intended Thing ID, optional field selections, and schema versioning.
